cards.card_text: The Gershonites camp on the west and look after the tent, its covering and the curtains, and the Kohathites camp on the south and care for the ark, the table, the lampstand and the altars.
cards.verse_text: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
cards.snippet: …Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.

cards.card_text: The LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, and Aaron the priest a job: count the Kohathites, one of the clans of the Levites.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families, men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
cards.snippet: …the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families, men from thirty to…

cards.card_text: The LORD says this Kohathite work regards the most holy things.
cards.verse_text: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
cards.snippet: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.

cards.card_text: When Aaron and his sons finish covering the holy objects and the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites finally come.
cards.verse_text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.
cards.snippet: …their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.

cards.card_text: Then the Kohathites come and do the ___.
cards.verse_text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.
cards.snippet: …their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.

cards.card_text: The Kohathites can touch the holy objects as long as they're careful.
cards.verse_text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.
cards.snippet: …their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses and Aaron again: "Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites."
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
cards.snippet: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.

cards.card_text: The LORD says that if the Kohathites go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, they will die.
cards.verse_text: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
cards.snippet: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even…

cards.card_text: And the Kohathites, another Levite clan, get ZERO carts and ZERO oxen.
cards.verse_text: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
cards.snippet: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for…

cards.card_text: Why do the Kohathites get no carts or oxen?
cards.verse_text: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
cards.snippet: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for…

cards.card_text: The Kohathites: the only movers whose truck is their own shoulders.
cards.verse_text: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
cards.snippet: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for…

cards.card_text: The Gershonites and Merarites carry the tabernacle after Judah, and the Kohathites carry the holy objects after Reuben, with the tabernacle to be set up before they arrive.
cards.verse_text: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.
cards.snippet: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set…

cards.card_text: The cities are handed out by lot, clan by clan, to the families of Levi's sons Kohath, Gershon and Merari (Exodus 6:16), and the first lot comes out for the Kohathites, starting with Aaron's descendants, the priests.
cards.verse_text: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans.
cards.snippet: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans.

cards.card_text: Then the rest of the Kohathites, the Gershomites and the Merarites get towns from tribe after tribe, so the Levites end up with towns on both sides of the Jordan.
cards.verse_text: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
cards.snippet: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.

cards.card_text: Some Kohathites, a Levite clan, prepare the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
cards.verse_text: Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
cards.snippet: Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.

cards.card_text: Six Levite clans come, each with its chief and between 80 and 220 relatives, starting with Uriel the chief and 120 Kohathites.
cards.verse_text: Then he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives; from the Merarites, Asaiah the chief and 220 of his relatives; from the Gershomites, Joel the chief and 130 of his relatives; from the Elizaphanites, Shemaiah the chief and 200 of his relatives; from the Hebronites, Eliel the chief and 80 of his relatives; and from the Uzzielites, Amminadab the chief and 112 of his relatives.
cards.snippet: …he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives; from the Merarites, Asaiah…

cards.card_text: Then the Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stand up and praise the LORD, shouting in a very loud voice, and NOBODY is whispering in that assembly.
cards.verse_text: And the Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, shouting in a very loud voice.
cards.snippet: And the Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel,…

cards.card_text: Kohathites, Merarites, Gershonites and more: it's a full roll call.
cards.verse_text: Then the Levites set to work: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the Kohathites; Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel from the Merarites; Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah from the Gershonites; Shimri and Jeuel from the Elizaphanites; Zechariah and Mattaniah from the Asaphites; Jehiel and Shimei from the Hemanites; and Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthunites.
cards.snippet: …work: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the Kohathites; Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel from the Merarites;…
